requests.body_half_extent_rule: Measured IFC profile. Rectangular profiles use max(width, height) / 2 without applying the duct orientation.

clearance_policy.baseline_occupancy: Obstacle AABBs are inflated by the measured route-body half-extent. Covering and proxy cells are blocked only when the cell centre is enclosed or within 1 mm of the mesh. Walls, slabs, and MEP keep their inflated AABBs.
clearance_policy.boundary_host_exception: Only the containing cell of a retained boundary host may be released, and only for that host. Samples in that cell are connection contact. The rest of the route is still checked against that host.
clearance_policy.clearance_aware_occupancy: AABB inflation and covering/proxy mesh contact both equal the body half-extent plus the declared additional clearance. The frozen A* implementation is unchanged.
clearance_policy.reason: BENCHMARK_V1 defines 0.05 m only between distinct synthetic systems. Same-system clearance is UNDEFINED. No DigitalHub duct-to-architecture clearance is declared.
clearance_policy.validation: The full physical polyline, including connector stubs and bends, is tested. Swept AABBs select candidates. Mesh surface distance of centreline samples then decides enclosure or clearance. Required separation is the body half-extent plus the declared additional clearance. Absence of a confirmed intersection is not sufficient clearance.
clearance_policy.voxel_limitation: A 0.1 m grid can miss features narrower than one cell. Occupancy uses cell centres, so a free cell can still be closer to a solid than the route body. Mesh validation of the reconstructed polyline is the geometric check. A 0.05 m run is a localized sensitivity when the adapter cell limit allows it.
clearance_policy.zero_aabb_hits: ZERO_BROAD_PHASE_CANDIDATES does not prove clearance. Those routes stay validation-incomplete.

selection_rule: Per discipline, skip the rejected H_RL 68 identity, then rank by straight-line length in [2 m, 8 m], shared system and storey, surrounding obstacle count, slab-AABB avoidance, distance to 5 m, and GlobalId. The frozen ZUL_R 2 ventilation identity is preferred first. Endpoints are never relocated.
